mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_file (revision_id, module, path, source_root, language, file_type, package_name, encoding , checksum, size_bytes, line_count, parse_status, parse_error) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{module}, #{path}, #{sourceRoot}, #{language}, #{fileType}, #{packageName}, #{encoding} , #{checksum}, #{sizeBytes}, #{lineCount, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{parseStatus}, #{parseError}) ON CONFLICT (revision_id, path) DO UPDATE SET module = EXCLUDED.module , source_root = EXCLUDED.source_root , language = EXCLUDED.language , file_type = EXCLUDED.file_type , package_name = EXCLUDED.package_name , encoding = EXCLUDED.encoding , checksum = EXCLUDED.checksum , size_bytes = EXCLUDED.size_bytes , line_count = EXCLUDED.line_count , parse_status = EXCLUDED.parse_status , parse_error = EXCLUDED.parse_error
mapper.select: SELECT file_id AS "fileId" , module AS "module" , path AS "path" , source_root AS "sourceRoot" , language AS "language" , file_type AS "fileType" , package_name AS "packageName" , encoding AS "encoding" , language_level AS "languageLevel" , checksum AS "checksum" , size_bytes AS "sizeBytes" , line_count AS "lineCount" , parse_status AS "parseStatus" , parse_error AS "parseError" FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND language = #{language} AND file_type = #{fileType} AND encoding = #{encoding} AND path LIKE '%' || #{pathLike} || '%' ORDER BY path LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT language AS "language" , file_type AS "fileType" , COUNT(*) AS "fileCount" , COALESCE(SUM(line_count), 0) AS "lineCount" , COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0) AS "sizeBytes" FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} GROUP BY language, file_type ORDER BY language, file_type
SELECT COALESCE(encoding, '(없음)') AS "encoding" , COUNT(*) AS "fileCount" FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} GROUP BY encoding ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT COALESCE(module, '') AS "module" , COALESCE(source_root, '(못 찾음)') AS "sourceRoot" , COUNT(*) AS "fileCount" FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND language = 'JAVA' GROUP BY module, source_root ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
